title: The Miner's Lantern
rumor: The Miner's Lantern. A yellow light occasionally appears deep within an abandoned working, moving slowly through passages long since collapsed. Prospectors claim it belongs to a miner who died searching for the richest vein in the mountains. Anyone who follows the light is said to discover gold, though not necessarily a way back to the surface.
first_lead: The lantern is associated with an old prospect known as Widow's Cut.
